title: Wendell and the Aftermath
author: A. M. Dunmore
blurb: Mara Kavanagh, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
